articles.title: Hiroshima and Nagasaki anniversary: What is the world’s nuclear status today?
articles.summary: The world observes the 81st anniversary of the devastating Hiroshima and Nagasaki nuclear bombings. These US attacks, conducted on August 6th and 9th during the final days of World War II, remain a poignant reminder of the horrors of nuclear warfare and its catastrophic human cost. The anniversaries serve as a global call for peace and nuclear disarmament, reflecting on the historical lessons learned.

articles.title: N Korean missile unit deployed in Russia, Ukraine says
articles.summary: Ukrainian military intelligence reports a North Korean missile unit is deploying to western Russia, potentially equipped with 120 ballistic missiles and six launchers for strikes against Ukraine. This significant development highlights deepening military cooperation between North Korea and Russia, indicating an increased foreign military presence and capability in the ongoing conflict, a crucial point for understanding global security dynamics.
